values.quote: forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and them for 2 seconds

values.meaning: Renewal self-heal (% missing health), each of two triggers
values.quote: heals for {{sti|health|{{as|17% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of her '''missing''' health}}}}
values.binNote: RWHealAmount computes (17 + 0.01xAP)*0.01, i.e. (0.17 + 0.0001xAP) as a fraction of missing health; matches wiki's 17% + 1% per 100 AP once expressed per-AP-point (0.01/100=0.0001).

mechanics.claim: The aftereffect damage/root only triggers if the tether is not broken by the end of its duration.
mechanics.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and is {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffect if the tether was already applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.

mechanics.claim: Renewal heals Karma once on cast and again when the tether completes or the target dies while tethered.
mechanics.quote: '''Karma''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself once on-cast, and again once the target is ''bound'' or dies while tethered.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or leaves sight during the cast time, the ability cancels without going on cooldown or paying its cost.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on {{sti|cooldown}} nor pay its cost.

mechanics.claim: If the target moves out of range during the cast time, the ability still goes on cooldown and pays its cost despite cancelling.
mechanics.quote: If they move too far away during the cast time, however, the ability will cancel as normal but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.

mechanics.claim: Even when cast is cancelled by the target moving away, Karma is still healed on-cast under Renewal.
